div.head: VI Atr 27.1
div.ab: ⁊ gearwige eac to huslgange huru þriwa on geare gehwa hine sylfne, þe his agene þearfe wille understandan, swa swa him þearf is.
⁊ gearwige eac to huselgange huru þriwa on geare gehwa hine silfne, þe his agene þearfe understandan cunne, swa swa him þearf sy.
⁊ gearwige eac to huslgange huru þriwa on geare gehwa hine sylfne þe his agene þearfe wille understandan, swa swa him þearf is.
And gearwige eac to huslgange huru þriwa on geare gehwa hine sylfne, þe his agene þearfe wille understandan, swa swa him þearf is.
Und jeder bereite sich auch zum Abendmahl wenigstens dreimal im Jahre, wer seinen eigenen Nutzen verstehen will (kann D), so wie ihm noth thut.
And let everyone who will (can, D) understand his own good prepare himself to go to communion at least three times a year, as he needs to.
And everyone who seeks to understand what is for his own good shall also prepare himself for sacrament at least three times in the year, as is his duty.
And anyone who wishes to understand his own obligations must prepare himself to receive the sacrament at least three times during the year, just as is required of him.
